newsitem.title: UK: Amoco and Tractebel sign gas agreement with Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Amoco and Tractebel sign gas agreement with Jordan.

text.p: US Amoco Corp and Belgium's Tractebel have signed an agreement with the Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources of Jordan to develop a natural gas pipeline system there.
Amoco said in a statement on Wednesday that the two companies will develop, build and operate a pipeline system within Jordan to transport, distribute and market natural gas.
Under the agreement, the two companies will be solely responsible for gas purchase agreements, transport, distribution and marketing through the new infrastructure.
Gas supplies will be used to meet requirements from the fertiliser industry, from major consumers and from power generation. Under the agreement, final implementation will be within 18 months.
